 p=root/folder/'native_states.npz'

   local=quaternion_rotate(quaternion_inverse(q),v);beta=np.arctan2(local[:,1],local[:,0]);error=np.arctan2(np.sin(beta-ref_beta),np.cos(beta-ref_beta))
   quality=np.exp(-(error/.12)**2)*(rs>.3)*(speed>.25);gate=np.where(rs>.3,quality,1.)
   anchor=np.exp(-np.sum((pos[:,:2]-rp[:,:2])**2,axis=-1)/.3**2);speedq=np.exp(-((speed-rs)/.35)**2)

   rows.append({'case':name,'engine':engine,'complete_core_windows':int(core.sum()),'body_frame_beta_error_rms_deg_proxy':float(np.degrees(np.sqrt(np.mean(error[core]**2)))),'mean_existing_beta_quality_proxy':float(quality[core].mean()),'positive_contact_credit_retained_if_beta_gated_proxy':float((bonus[core]*gate[core]).sum()/bonus[core].sum()),'F_contact_raw_mean_on_saved_inputs_proxy':float(parts['raw_reward'][core].mean()),'beta_gated_F_raw_mean_on_saved_inputs_proxy':float((bonus*gate-parts['support_gap_penalty'])[core].mean()),'root_tilt_mean_p95_deg_diagnostic_not_gate':[float(tilt[core].mean()),float(np.percentile(tilt[core],95))],'input_archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
